versions.changelog: Added changelog section, fixed version in frontmatter
Generalized all agent names in archetypes and examples

Initial release of Agent Soul Crafter.

- Provides a comprehensive SOUL.md framework for designing consistent, compelling AI agent personalities.
- Includes structured sections: Identity Core, Personality Traits, Expertise/Domain, Response Rules, Communication Style, and Boundaries & Safety.
- Offers detailed templates and concrete examples for each section.
- Supplies pre-built personality archetypes for common agent roles.
- Highlights common anti-patterns and best practices.
- Features a quality checklist for ensuring agent reliability and appeal before deployment.
